name: app/data-table
title: DataTable
summary: A real <table> with a caption and scoped headers, that becomes one card per row on narrow screens so a phone never scrolls sideways. Cells are data, never markup.

props.name: showCaption
props.description: Show the caption to sighted readers.

props.name: columns
props.type: { key: string; label: string; align?: "start" | "end"; primary?: boolean }[]
props.description: Columns; the first column's cells are row headers.

props.name: rows
props.description: Cell = string | number | null | undefined | { text, href?, badge?, tone?, mono?, sub?, current? }. `badge` is a registry badge variant (default, secondary, destructive, outline, ghost, link); `tone` is a status pill: "neutral" | "success" | "warning" | "info" | "accent" | "premium".

props.name: rowKey
props.description: Key whose text becomes each row's data-row.

behaviour: Cell text is escaped: a row cannot inject markup.
An empty cell shows a dash to the eye and "none" to a screen reader.
A cell with `current` marks its row aria-current="true".

A cell with `tone` is a status pill (data-slot="status", data-tone) in a fixed status colour: success malachite, warning gold, info cobalt, accent terracotta, premium tanzanite, neutral muted. Its text is escaped like any cell's. `tone` wins over `badge`.
Filtering and paging are server-side (`@bundu/ui/lib/table`); pair with FilterBar or Toolbar and Pagination.

status.description: Status pills in three tones, one with hostile text.

aria: Phone card labels are aria-hidden duplicates of the headers.

theming.brandOverlay: Cell links are `--primary`. Rows and spacing are the same in every brand. Status pills (`tone`) are fixed status colours, the same in every brand.

noJs.without: Everything: the component is server-rendered HTML with no script.

responsive: Below md each row is a card and each cell shows its column name; from md it is a table with a header row and ~40px rows.
contract:
contract
  slot is "data-table"
  when default shows a "Tendai"
  uses badge
  when hostile slot is "data-table"
end

checks.say: An empty cell is spoken as none.
A tone cell is a status pill.
Every tone cell is a pill; tone wins over badge.
A tone cell with a badge renders no badge.
A status pill's text cannot inject markup.
Phone labels are hidden from screen readers.
